name: openviewer-page-flip
description: Vendored + patched StPageFlip (page-flip) ESM build. Patches: Flip.stopMove always completes a released USER_FOLD fold from its current position, the built-in spine shadow is widened to overlap its gradients more closely, the spine (crease) shadow is only drawn in landscape spreads so a single page has no gutter shadow, and image onload handlers are registered before source assignment to avoid loader flashes.
